title: Dynamic ICU Bed Allocation Under Resource Scarcity: Simulation Engine, LP Bounds, and HU-UFMA Empirical Calibration
description: Continuous-time discrete-event simulation (DES) and retrospective time-indexed linear programming (LP) upper bounds (Hindsight LP and Duration-Expectation LP) for multi-type ICU bed allocation under resource scarcity, calibrated with DATASUS/CNES bed capacities (HU-UFMA, 55 beds) and AMIB/Epimed Brazilian ICU registry targets.

creators.name: Carvalho, João Augusto Ferreira Nunes de
